name: BIND9
description: ISC BIND 9 authoritative DNS and recursive resolver from Debian 13 packages. Initially listens on loopback only. Supports DNSSEC, TSIG, primary/secondary replication and dnstap; configure these before exposing DNS to clients.

notes.text: The initial resolver listens on loopback only. Configure listen-on, allow-query, allow-recursion and zone transfer ACLs before using it on the network.
No web UI is bundled. Stork, primary/secondary replication, TSIG updates and dnstap collection are optional separate configuration steps. See docs/scripts/bind9.md.
Uses Debian security-maintained packages. The update function validates configuration and stores a protected configuration and zone backup under /opt before upgrading.
